item.title: Gov Idris directs immediate investigation of fire at Kebbi Quranic school
item.description: Governor of Kebbi State, Nasir Idris, has ordered an immediate investigation into the fire outbreak at Nurul Haqq Quranic and Arabic School in Birnin Kebbi. The incident, which occurred on Saturday evening, affected several hostels and classrooms within the school premises. In a statement issued by the Special Adviser to the Governor on Media and […] Gov Idris directs immediate investigation of fire at Kebbi Quranic school

item.title: Iran war: Israel shuts schools, bans gatherings
item.description: Israel on Saturday banned public gatherings, shut schools and workplaces and moved hospital patients to underground facilities as Iran launched missiles in retaliation for a joint US-Israeli attack on Iran. Defence Minister Israel Katz made this known, declaring a state of emergency across the country and warning the public of Iranian missile and drone attacks. item.title: Borno: Police intercept 13 sacks of vandalised high-tension cables, arrest two suspects
item.description: Operatives of the Rapid Response Squad, RRS, under the Anti-Social Vice Unit of the Borno State Police Command have arrested two suspected high-tension electric cable vandals in Gubio Local Government Area. item.title: Ali Khamenei’s death: Iran declares 40 days of mourning
item.description: Iran has announced 40 days of national mourning and declared seven days of public holiday following the death of its Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. The declaration was broadcast on state television on Sunday after Iranian authorities formally confirmed his death. State-run broadcaster IRINN replaced regular programming with Quran recitations and archival images of Khamenei, […] Ali Khamenei’s death: Iran declares 40 days of mourning

item.description: Several loud noises were heard in the Dubai area of the United Arab Emirates on Sunday for the second day in a row, according to witnesses who told Reuters news agency. item.title: ‘Lucky soul, he died in jihad’ – Sheikh Gumi reacts to Ali Khamenei’s death
item.description: Islamic cleric, Sheikh Ahmad Gumi, has reacted to the reported death of Iran’s Supreme Leader, Ali Khamenei. Gumi described him as “a lucky soul” who “died in jihad.” In a post shared on his Facebook page on Sunday, Gumi said Khamenei died “in jihad against killers of innocent children and women in Gaza and elsewhere.” […] ‘Lucky soul, he died in jihad’ – Sheikh Gumi reacts to Ali Khamenei’s death
